steps.start: the point of intersection of the northerly boundary of the right of way of Highway 3A and the westerly natural boundary of Beaver Creek
steps.quote: Commencing at the point of intersection of the northerly boundary of the right of way of Highway 3A and the westerly natural boundary of Beaver Creek

steps.until: the point of intersection with the midline of Peters Road
steps.quote: thence southerly along the westerly natural boundary of Beaver Creek to the point of intersection with the midline of Peters Road

steps.until: the point of intersection with the southerly boundary of Sublot 101, Kootenay Land District
steps.quote: thence southerly along the midline of Peters Road to the point of intersection with the southerly boundary of Sublot 101, Kootenay Land District

steps.until: the point of intersection with the natural boundary of Crawford Bay
steps.quote: thence easterly along the southerly boundary and along the southerly boundary of Lot 2335 to the point of intersection with the natural boundary of Crawford Bay

steps.until: the point least distant from the junction of Highway 3A and Crawford Creek Road
steps.quote: thence in a general easterly direction along the natural boundary of Crawford Bay on the northerly shore thereof to the point least distant from the junction of Highway 3A and Crawford Creek Road

steps.until: the point of intersection with the easterly boundary of the right of way of Crawford Creek Road
steps.quote: thence easterly to the point of intersection with the easterly boundary of the right of way of Crawford Creek Road

steps.side_or_bank: easterly boundary of the right of way
steps.until: the point of intersection with the westerly boundary of the right of way of Wadds Road
steps.quote: thence northerly along the easterly boundary to the point of intersection with the westerly boundary of the right of way of Wadds Road

steps.side_or_bank: westerly boundary of the right of way
steps.until: the point of intersection with the northerly boundary of the right of way of Highway 3A
steps.quote: thence southerly along the westerly boundary to the point of intersection with the northerly boundary of the right of way of Highway 3A

steps.side_or_bank: northerly boundary of the right of way
steps.quote: thence westerly along the northerly boundary to the point of commencement
